✨Chhaon Stays - Hostel & Cafe ✨

Where the mountains cast their spell and time slows down.

Just 3 km away from Jibhi, tucked away in a peaceful village called Shoja, Himachal high up in the hills. Chhaon Stays is your ultimate escape to unwind and recharge.

We offer 3 cozy rooms and 2 dorms, each with breathtaking mountain views, a cozy attic space, and a peaceful balcony perfect for sipping chai and watching the clouds float by.

What Do we Offer? 
🌿3 private rooms
🌿2 dorm rooms
🌿A cozy cafe
🌿An Attic space

We offer a charming rustic haven with snug indoor spots for the cozy crowd and open-air seating for those who love the fresh mountain breeze. Coffee, conversations, and jaw-dropping views.

Send us a message, We can’t wait to welcome you! 🤍

How to reach Chhaon Stays & Cafe, Shoja 🚗🌲

Hidden in a quiet corner of Himachal, Shoja feels like a secret, but getting here is simpler than it looks.

🚌 By Bus:
Take an overnight Volvo to Aut from Delhi or Chandigarh. From there, catch a local bus private cab or shared taxi to Shoja (1.5 hours away).

🚗 By Cab / Car / Bike:
From Delhi or Chandigarh, Shoja is around 450–500km.
Drive via Aut – Banjar – Jibhi – Shoja. The roads are scenic, especially if you’re on a bike trip or self-drive getaway.

✈️ By Air:
Land at Bhuntar Airport (Kullu-Manali), the closest airport — about 2 hours from Shoja by road.

💡 Bonus tip:
Book your journey via Zingbus — it not only brings you to Aut but automatically books a connecting cab to drop you right at our gate.

📞 Need help booking or finding the best route? We’re always a call away. Call at +91 99530 64180

Hi, meet Amrit — the host, the showrunner, the one you’ll almost always spot somewhere around Chhaonstay, holding his dapo and playing with the wind 🌬️ What began as something casual, almost meaningless, slowly grew into something much larger for him. In the beginning, he spun the dapo just to feel the breeze, just to pass time. But somewhere along the way, he realised he could shape the wind—create his own tricks, his own rhythm. That’s when it shifted from habit to craft.

The smiles, the curious eyes, the quiet appreciation from people pulled him deeper into it. He found joy not just in doing it, but in watching others enjoy it. Without realising when or how, the dapo stopped being a pastime and became his identity—his art, his signature. Every time a new guest arrives, there’s always that familiar request: “bhaiya, jo aap Instagram story pe ghumate ho na, wo karke dikhao na.” And somehow, that feeling never fades.

Today, Chhaon wanted to share this small piece of his journey as a daposter at Chhaonstay. Because sometimes, the simplest things we do just for fun quietly turn into the most beautiful parts of who we are 🌿🌬️

Some days, people who carry art inside them just find their way to the same table. No introduction , no performances just hands shaping clay, mountains standing still in the background, and a café that lets you stay a little longer than planned. Nobody is trying to create something perfect. We’re just sitting together, letting our hands do what the mind can’t explain.

It’s strange how easy it feels here sharing silence, small smiles, unfinished stories. Art doesn’t ask who you are or where you come from; it only asks you to show up. On this mountainside, between chai sips and clay dust, strangers feel less like strangers. Maybe this is what Chhaon really is a pause where people meet, create, and quietly feel human again.

Chhaon was started with the purpose of being an escape for travellers who are looking for peace and quiet from their otherwise busy and complicated life. 

All of us are fighting some or the other evils of our own. All we need is a space where we can feel alive, to find the strength to fight our evils or a space where we can introspect, to help us look at life from a different perspective, a space where we are free from any fear of being judged and we can finally be the real us. 

Where things don't have to be perfect, where we learn to see and appreciate the imperfections of life. When we let go of the privileges we get in our daily city life, only then we realise that this world is way bigger than we think and our problems are nothing compared to that. This life is so much more than we think it is.

And that's what mountain life teaches us: life can be very difficult but still it can be very beautiful. The challenges we face here make us feel how small other problems are or probably it gives us the mental strength to fight them. And that's why people come to the mountains. 

And when we see that we are playing a small role in someone's happiness by providing them a space where they can feel alive, it feels like a personal win.

Just 30 minutes drive from Shoja, the trail to Raghupur Fort begins at Jalori Pass - one of the most beautiful short Himalayan treks you can experience while staying in the valley.

A gentle forest walk through oak & rhododendron trees slowly opens into wide alpine meadows where the ruins of the historic fort stand quietly at around 12000ft altitude, offering breathtaking 360° views of the Himalayas. 🏔️

It’s not just a trek - it’s a place to pause

🌄 Watch sunrise above endless mountain layers

🌅 Stay for golden sunsets over the bugyals

⛺ Camp under open Himalayan skies

✨ Experience some of the clearest stargazing near Shoja

📸 Walk across peaceful meadows that feel untouched by time

One of the most rewarding experiences to add during your stay at Shoja & Chhaon.
